summary: Day one of five on the risk-off call (confidence 0.4) went mildly its way but settles nothing. SPY marked 754.37 at the close against 757.12 the day before (-0.36%; VOO -0.63%, VTI -0.59% on the day), so it gave back only a sliver of the +3.29% 5-day bounce. The SPY benchmark value went from 592.67 to 590.52. Risk-off needs SPY more than 1% lower after 5 sessions, so it needs about another 0.7% down by 11-19, with Nvidia's 11-17 print in the window. The defensive tilts held up within equities: DPZ +2.34%, KR +1.42%, WMT +1.23%, IDXX +0.81% and INCY +0.25% rose while SPY fell. Of the names in avoided sectors, FAST (Industrials) fell 0.74% but CARG (Communication) rose 1.58%. BND was flat (-0.01%) and still NEAR its $70 stop (mark 70.56). Bonds neither hedged nor fell further on the day, and the close file gives nothing more on rates.
update: Keep risk-off at about 0.4 confidence going into 11-16. Nothing in the close file breaks the morning reasoning: SPY held 3.48% above its 200-day stop line (754.37 vs 728.98), so the regime filter stays on and this is a sizing call, not a regime call. 'Held up' here means it was not contradicted on day one. It is not a grade. One -0.36% day is noise against 22.6% 20-day realized vol. The leading signals were left unconfirmed either way because close.json has no TLT, HYG, LQD, UUP or VIXY marks. Tomorrow's packet should be checked for credit (LQD 5d -1.54%, HYG -0.39%) and TLT (5d -2.70%): if they stabilize while SPY holds above about 750, move to neutral, per the morning watch list. A further SPY slide toward the 21-day low with VIXY turning up would raise confidence. The staples and health-care leadership on a down day (DPZ, KR, WMT all up more than 1%) supports the favor list, but WMT reports 11-19 inside the window and the book trimmed it today, so one day of staples strength shouldn't widen that tilt. Note for the Reviewer: my 13 graded calls are 8 right (61.5%), exactly the always-neutral baseline (0.615), and this is my first directional call since the 11-05 neutral miss. Grade it on its own 5-session outcome, not on today.
